version: LOCK 53 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - side mission: The neighbour's wall
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner; LOCK 3 and LOCK 6 regulars; River Market places (LOCK 1). Each mission is its own LOCK and queue line.

missions.title: The neighbour's wall
missions.button: Nadir and Saif are arguing over a wall

a.text: Nadir wants to rest a roof beam on the wall he shares with Saif, to shade his loom. Saif says the wall is his and refuses. They ask you to decide.

choices.label: Ask Saif gently to let the beam rest
Side with Saif - it is his wall

beam.text: “A wall that holds up your neighbour's roof is a good wall,” you say. Saif grumbles, then helps Nadir lift the beam into place.

saif.text: Saif smiles. Nadir works in the sun all summer.

out.text: They go to the qadi. It takes a month.
